raw_finding.title: t.Fatal called from a.Do callback
raw_finding.message: t.Fatal is called inside a closure passed to a.Do, which may run on a different goroutine than the test. FailNow must be called from the test goroutine, so these calls may not stop the test properly and can leave the app state inconsistent.
raw_finding.suggestion: Use t.Error and return from the closure, or capture the failure in a variable and call t.Fatal after a.Do returns.

dispositions.reason: The claimed goroutine handoff does not exist. Application.Do at app/app.go:278-304 acquires owner, validates state and directly invokes fn() at301 on its calling goroutine. The test calls a.Do directly within its t.Run subtest body; no callback queue or go statement intervenes. Blocking on owner does not transfer goroutine identity. t.Fatal therefore executes on that subtest goroutine.
dispositions.unwind: FailNow/Goexit still runs deferred rs.Release and Application.Do cleanup. Do unlocks owner and closes on nonreturning callback; registered test cleanups remain in the same test lifetime. The claim does not justify replacing Fatal or adding a generic callback workaround.
